title: Anyone been to a hotel/mall?
content: Dreamt it this morning. Never been to this one. I was inside the while time. The one entrance had escalators going up and down. Once inside it was very well lit. It was a white mall with white walls. Inside there were escalators that were flat, like in airports. Also this mall had hotel rooms. They were like suits, not small rooms. They had tall ceilings. Lots of people here. Normally I'm in a part of the world that's run down/destroyed/post-apocalyptic. This was far from that. Everyone was dressed nice, wealthy looking. It was also known as a place where people hooked up with escorts. Random but new for me
